policy: Reference intakes and safety ceilings are not prescribed supplement doses. No automatic dose until indication-specific evidence and QA.
supported_context: population- and outcome-specific cardiovascular evidence; no universal benefit claim for all users

protocols.amount: No universal EPA+DHA dose established for all goals
4 g/day trial regimens are indication/product-specific, not general self-care

personalization: Separate EPA and DHA quantities and formulation; diet and cardiovascular diagnosis affect relevance, not an automatic dose.
safety: anticoagulants/bleeding context and surgery require review
atrial fibrillation signal with high-dose regimens in some populations
next_review: Differentiate prescription EPA for selected hypertriglyceridemia/cardiovascular indications from OTC mixed omega-3.
